name: Prey Population
definition: The number of prey animals (e.g., rabbits) in the ecosystem at a given time.

name: Predator Population
definition: The number of predator animals (e.g., foxes) in the ecosystem at a given time.

name: Prey Birth Rate
definition: The rate at which new prey are born, typically proportional to the current prey population.

name: Prey Death Rate
definition: The rate at which prey die, primarily due to predation (encounters with predators).

name: Predator Birth Rate
definition: The rate at which new predators are born, dependent on successful predation (food availability).

name: Predator Death Rate
definition: The rate at which predators die, typically from natural causes when food is scarce.
